title: UN Human Rights Chief Issues High Alert: 880 Civilians Killed by Drone Strikes January–April 2026
detail: UN Human Rights Chief Volker Türk issued a 'high alert' on May 11, 2026, strongly condemning the rising use of armed unmanned aerial vehicles in Sudan's civil war and warning of intensified and widening violence in the coming weeks. The OHCHR reported that at least 880 civilians were killed and more than 770 injured by drone strikes between January and April 2026 — a significant increase beyond the Q1-only estimate of 700+ previously cited. Drone strikes accounted for over 80% of all conflict-related civilian deaths documented in this period. Civilian markets were targeted at least 28 times, and health facilities were struck at least 12 times. Türk's statement specifically cited May 8 drone strikes in Al Quz (South Kordofan) and near El Obeid (North Kordofan) that killed at least 26 civilians. The OHCHR noted both SAF and RSF continue to use armed drones against populated areas with documented civilian impact. Türk warned that the combination of intensifying drone warfare, continued obstruction of humanitarian access, the escalating Sudan-Ethiopia-UAE confrontation, and RSF troop movements near the Libya-Egypt-Sudan border triangle create conditions for 'widening conflict' that would further devastate civilian populations across multiple front lines. The statement follows the UN Secretary-General's condemnation of the April 10 Kutum wedding massacre and the UN's 2026 humanitarian appeal remaining only 16% funded.

title: SAF Drone Strikes Hit Nyala Second Consecutive Day; RSF Bayraktar Akıncı UCAV Downed Over Nyala Airport
detail: Sudanese Armed Forces (SAF) drone strikes targeted RSF positions in Nyala, South Darfur for the second consecutive day on May 11, 2026, with at least three explosions reported striking central Nyala, the international airport area, and the Al-Riyadh neighborhood. The SAF claimed the combined May 10–11 strikes destroyed 240 RSF military vehicles and killed hundreds of RSF fighters — figures that could not be independently verified. In a significant tactical development, SAF Air Defense Forces reported shooting down a Turkish-made Baykar Bayraktar Akıncı unmanned combat aerial vehicle (UCAV) operated by the RSF over Nyala Airport. The Bayraktar Akıncı is a more advanced, heavier UCAV than the previously documented TB2, capable of carrying larger payloads and operating at greater ranges. Its reported deployment with RSF indicates a potential upgrade in RSF unmanned aerial capabilities, likely supplied through Turkey–UAE networks. The downing adds to the pattern of drone-on-drone aerial warfare over South Darfur. Nyala is the capital of South Darfur State and Sudan's second-largest city, under complete RSF control since October 2023, and serves as the seat of the RSF-backed 'Government of Peace and Unity.'

media.caption: SAF drones strike Nyala second consecutive day; RSF Bayraktar Akıncı UCAV downed over Nyala Airport — Sudan Tribune, May 11, 2026
